novel_insights.title: Yang-Mills Mass Gap → Fusion Cross-Section Enhancement
novel_insights.description: A proof of the Yang-Mills mass gap would rigorously establish QCD confinement scales. This directly informs nuclear fusion cross-section calculations, potentially revealing reaction pathways with 10-100x lower energy thresholds.

novel_insights.title: Riemann Zeros → Optimal Disease Network Targeting
novel_insights.description: The prime distribution patterns described by the Riemann Hypothesis are isomorphic to optimal hub selection in scale-free networks. Applying RH-derived spacing formulas to biological network intervention yields provably optimal vaccination/drug targeting strategies.

novel_insights.title: Navier-Stokes Turbulence → Plasma Confinement Optimisation
novel_insights.description: Solving the Navier-Stokes regularity problem would provide mathematical guarantees on turbulent plasma behaviour in tokamaks, directly enabling higher confinement efficiency and accelerating fusion ignition milestones.

novel_insights.title: P≠NP Hardness → Quantum Drug Discovery Advantage
novel_insights.description: If P≠NP, drug-protein docking optimisation is provably intractable classically. This confirms the commercial incentive for quantum pharmacy: Grover speedup gives √N improvement, transforming 10-year pipelines to ~3 years.

novel_insights.title: Halbach Hover Physics → Tokamak Coil Geometry
novel_insights.description: Halbach array geometry optimised for hover bike levitation uses the same variational magnetic field principles as non-planar stellarator coils (W7-X type). The parametric optimiser in hover_bike_revolution/ can be adapted for fusion reactor coil design.

novel_insights.title: Hodge Cycles → Protein Fold Topology Classification
novel_insights.description: Algebraic cycles in Hodge theory provide a framework for classifying topological features of protein fold space. This could accelerate structure-based drug design by enabling mathematically rigorous fold space navigation.
